fixed_shape_parameters.update: W -> m * (W0 + scale * B@A) / ||W0 + scale * B@A||_row (weight-decomposed: generated rank-8 direction plus one generated magnitude scalar per output channel, the latter a delta on the frozen row norms; the renormalizing denominator is detached)
fixed_shape_parameters.budget_note: the locked rank-8 LoRA budget plus d_out for the magnitude vector (32768 + 1024 per layer, +3.1%); the magnitude vector is DoRA's shape identity, not a tunable extra

selection_trail.summary: DoRA's declared x4 ladder (0.0625-16, centred on its own identity convention) was retrieval-dead at the 512-token in-distribution gate at every point through 32k at the substrate-default LR 4e-5, as were both allowed upward extensions (64 and 256, the declared safety limit); a 32-example re-score of the only nonzero point (scale 4, gate 1/12) resolved it DOWN to 1/32, confirming a sampling artifact rather than a weak effect. Rather than publish a negative that had never probed the learning rate every other confirmed D2A codec selected, an explicitly EXPLORATORY screen (declared in the ledger, scout seed and dev eval instrument only, free axes only) swept scale x LR at a short 8k budget and found the window: scale 64 is gate-zero at LR 4e-5 but reaches gate 0.833 by 8k at LR 2e-5. DoRA's scale and LR axes therefore INTERACT, which is why a ladder swept at a single LR read as flat. The operating point was then re-derived on protocol at the full instrument: scales 32/64/128 at LR 2e-5 all reach the gate ceiling of 1.000 (hard-length AUC 0.983/1.000/0.983, a tied set of three; 64 promoted as the AUC argmax without claiming a resolved optimum among them), the upper endpoint 128 does not beat 64 so no further extension is licensed, and the LR axis closes interior at 2e-5 (4e-5 gate-zero, 1e-5 collapses to 0.083). The section 3b stability gate passed 3/3 on selection seeds 6201/6202/6203 (gates 1.000/0.500/1.000, divergence rate 0/3) - the same gate that ruled steering's analogous scale-64 point ineligible at 1/3. Five fresh confirmation seeds on the held-out eval instrument retained the result.
